items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Unauthenticated RCE via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eleven vulnerabilities, with the most severe being a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8) leading to unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: This bulletin resolves eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild, known as 'StyleSmuggler.'

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, with the most severe being an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that could lead to privilege escalation. Successful exploitation could also result in security feature bypass and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Unauthenticated RCE via Webhooks and Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This bulletin resolves thirteen vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated arbitrary code execution flaw in webhooks (CVE-2026-48358, CVSS 10.0) and an unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) that could lead to privilege escalation.
